description: GET /api/stock/records responds with Content-Type application/json (never text/html) for both the unfiltered and the ?location= filtered request

Downgrading the S2 add-index migration to its own down_revision then upgrading head on the paired branch recreates ix_stock_records_location_sku on (location, sku) in stock_records (schema recreated; marked @pytest.mark.migration)
Rows seeded under a per-run-unique key in stock_records before the S2 add-index migration is applied survive the migration with their sku, location, quantity and tracking_code values unchanged
